me.kaiyan.missilewarfare.util

Class BlockDataCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • me.kaiyan.missilewarfare.util.BlockDataCompat

  • public final class BlockDataCompat
extends java.lang.Object
    Version-safe access to the modern org.bukkit.block.data.BlockData API (1.13+). All references to those types live here as reflective Class.forName lookups so that classes loaded at plugin enable never carry org.bukkit.block.data.* in their bytecode, which would fail the JVM verifier on 1.8.8 where those classes are absent.

    On legacy versions every method degrades gracefully to a no-op or a best-effort legacy equivalent.

        public static int setRedstoneWirePower(@Nonnull
                                       org.bukkit.block.Block block,
                                       boolean powered)
        Drives a RedstoneWire block to either full or zero power on 1.13+ and returns the power level applied (the maximum when powered, otherwise 0). On legacy versions the wire is left untouched and 0 is returned.
